projects.title: Supported
projects.description:
- Supported is a Pebble watch app that lets you discretely call and text your emergency contacts in times where taking out a phone and dialing might be dangerous. 
- With a click of a button on the pebble watch, Supported sends SOS text messages with your current location to three of your preset contacts from the companion android app
- My major contributions in this project include: designing the pebble application to appear like the watch face, clock functionality, created the logic for sending inputs from the watch to the phone, building and implementing the emergency contacts page on the android companion app.

projects.title: Wakeup Time!!
projects.description:
•	Achievements: 2nd Place

•	Responsible for creating the stop alarm mechanism using Android App API.

Technologies: Java, Android Studio
